description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 scores of different MADLLM configurations across six datasets: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The vertical axis represents the F1 score percentage, ranging from 60% to 100%. The horizontal axis lists the datasets. The bars are color-coded to represent different configurations: green for MADLLM, blue for MADLLM without feature embedding, purple for MADLLM without prompt pool, and orange for MADLLM without skip embedding. The MADLLM configuration generally shows higher F1 scores across all datasets, with the highest scores observed in the PSM and SWaT datasets. The MADLLM without feature embedding configuration tends to have lower F1 scores, particularly in the WADI dataset. The MADLLM without prompt pool and MADLLM without skip embedding configurations show intermediate F1 scores, with the MADLLM without prompt pool configuration performing better in the MSL dataset. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
